name: slider
gotchas: Since the Material Design Components rewrite, `mat-slider` no longer takes `value`/`(input)`/`(change)` directly — it's a container around a native `<input matSliderThumb>` (or two inputs with `matSliderStartThumb`/`matSliderEndThumb` for a range slider), and value binding/events live on that inner `<input>`, not on `mat-slider` itself.

`discrete` and `showTickMarks` only produce visible tick marks and a value-indicator tooltip when `step` is set to a non-continuous value — a `mat-slider` without an explicit `step` still renders as a smooth slider even with both inputs present.

A range slider's two thumbs (`matSliderStartThumb`/`matSliderEndThumb`) each bind independently and don't automatically keep `start <= end` — enforce that ordering yourself in a value-change handler if your app logic depends on it.
